correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
I3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); O3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])
# Hypothesis: each row is the same cyclic sequence of length P, shifted by one per row (diagonal stripe), 
# except solid background bands. Fit: value(r,c) = seq[(c + s(r)) % P]. Use fully known rows 12..27 (26 wide) plus row 2 etc.
full=[r for r in range(28) if not any(I3[r][c]==0 for c in range(2,28))]
print('fully known rows',full)
seq=None
# pick longest run; try each row as reference and find P, shift relation across rows
ref_rows=[r for r in range(12,28)]
for P in range(2,28):
    for ref in ref_rows:
        q=list(O3[ref][2:2+P]) if False else None
        # derive shift from row comparison: row ref vs next known row ref+1: does row(ref+1)[c] == row(ref)[(c+1)%P] or [(c-1)%P]?
        ok=True; dr=ref+1
        while dr<28 and not any(I3[dr][c]==0 for c in range(2,28)):
            sh=c if False else None
            match_plus=all(O3[dr][c]==O3[ref][(c+1)%P] for c in range(2,28))
            match_minus=all(O3[dr][c]==O3[ref][(c-1)%P] for c in range(2,28))
            if not(match_plus or match_minus): ok=False;break
            dr+=1
        if ok: print('P=',P,'consistent', 'shift+1' if match_plus else 'shift-1')
